metadata.standard_reference: ISO/IEC 30107-3:2023 (Biometric Presentation Attack Detection - Testing & Reporting)

attack_presentation_species.instrument: High-Resolution Printed Photograph on Paper / Matte
attack_presentation_species.defense_mechanism: Server-side landmark temporal motion variance (< 0.5px flags static presentation)

attack_presentation_species.instrument: Digital Tablet / Smartphone Screen Video Replay
attack_presentation_species.defense_mechanism: Interactive random challenge sequence (e.g. smile then turn left) + 4s step timeout
Client motion guidance + challenge nonce binding
attack_presentation_species.limitation: Without Android Play Integrity hardware attestation, OS-level virtual camera hooks can inject synthetic frames.

overall_pad_classification: HEURISTIC_SOFTWARE_PAD (Non-STQC certified; sufficient for S-0/S-1, requires hardware attestation for S-2)
